facts.text: Evan believes in love at first sight and describes the experience as feeling like time stopped and a spark lit inside him.

evidence.quote: I totally believe in it. It was like time stopped and I felt like a spark lit inside me - it was so right.

facts.text: Evan mentions that he was in love with the woman from Canada at first sight and expresses regret for not marrying her earlier.

evidence.quote: Yes, that's her, I don't know why we didn't get married before, because I was in love with her at first sight!

facts.text: Evan describes love as bringing happiness and fulfillment, comparing it to a beautiful sunset that lights up their lives and brings peace.

evidence.quote: Love is truly amazing. It brings so much happiness and fulfillment, like a beautiful sunset that lights up our lives and brings peace.

facts.text: Evan references an image of a person sitting on a rock near the water, which is associated with his experience of love at first sight.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of a person sitting on a rock near the water]
